name: RUST & ROPE
author: Addicting Games
description:
The floor is literally lava, and the only way out is UP.

Take control of an agile Scrap Spider in Rust & Rope, a lightning-fast vertical grappling game where hesitation means melting. Armed with a high-tension grapple hook, you must swing, zip, and climb your way through a crumbling, infinitely generating industrial shaft while a deadly tide of magma chases you from below.

Master the physics of the swing, dodge treacherous ice walls that kill your momentum, and collect scrap coins to upgrade your bot into an unstoppable climbing machine.

Features:

* Precision Grappling Physics: Aim, shoot, and pull yourself through the air. String together mid-air grapples to build massive speed and outrun the rising heat.
* Dynamic Environments: Navigate through shifting biomes. Stick safely to the metal chunks, but beware the ice sections where you will helplessly slide down!
* The Power Ten Upgrades: Spend your hard-earned coins in the shop to permanently upgrade your stats. Increase your zip speed, magnet range, coin multipliers, or buy revives to save a doomed run.
* Game-Changing Powerups: Smash into powerups to activate a protective Shield or ignite your Overdrive Rocket thrusters to blast upward in a state of pure invincibility.
* Fierce Daily Competition: Compete against players worldwide on the Daily Leaderboard to win massive coin payouts and exclusive revive tokens.
* Chase the World Record: Leave your mark on the game. The highest score ever achieved by anyone is physically immortalized as a Golden Flag high up in the level for all other players to see—until someone climbs high enough to break it!

How high can you climb before the heat catches up?
